classification.rationale: The articles are named parts of electric fuel pumps. Under section XVI note 2(b) and heading 8413 (parts thereof), the parts go to 8413.91.90.15, parts of subheading 8413.30.90 fuel pumps, consistent with N011941 (fuel pump housing and outlet parts classified as parts of 8413.30.90 pumps, under the older numbering 8413.91.9010).
